source: original 90 clean D2 model cases from SE/QU registration batches

bias.location: post-training output, same float32 shift in API and differentiable model

factorial.reuse: UU from U coupled custom branch; AA from corresponding coupled custom branch. AU/UA separately executed. Each of 14 actual searches charged once.

search.delivery: best observed finite box-feasible own-objective loss

analysis.secondary_family: 9 coupled rules minus U * 3 regimes * 2 targets
analysis.weight_changes: single_shift minus control at fixed target; descriptive seed-paired intervals
analysis.other: all means, n, failure, bootstrap ordinary95 plus family intervals; no equivalence inference

limits: Reused models, new controlled-bias stress extension; no fresh-model confirmation
No renewed gate, no retraining, high inversion residuals retained
Cross-regime changes include newly inverted anchors; factorial comparisons hold anchors fixed within regime
Bias amount and rules fixed without target-error selection; positive offset only
Common bias preserves fixed-input disagreement within declared float32 tolerance
Truth is offline only and never selects alpha or endpoint
Lopt across different objective alpha is not a common quality score
Factorial effects describe this custom path and budget; direction alpha is not coefficient beta
No alpha calibration, actual payment, or strategy-proofness claim
